summary: Oceanhawk Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its initial public offering of 16,000,000 units at $10.00/unit ($160M gross proceeds), each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of one Class A ordinary share. The filing also covers entry into customary IPO agreements (underwriting, rights agreement, letter agreement, trust agreement, registration rights). As a blank-check company IPO, this is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation involving a business combination or other transformative event.
